golden_baseline_location: procs/oracle/transcripts/invoicing/INVOICE-001..006.json (6 immutable Oracle transcripts, pinned by procs/oracle/transcripts/ORACLE_SOURCE_SHA; see .migration/12_golden_baselines.md), plus federated LIVE comparison of invoices and invoice_lines. Pilot unit. procs/transcripts/ is the Postgres cross-check set, not the baseline.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (T1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.

loaded_rows + quarantined_rows == source_rows for every table in the unit, and the quarantine count is reported next to every money figure (T2/T3, §Quarantine). Quarantine above 5% of source rows halts the unit and escalates (STOPA-QUARANTINE).
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.
All 6 invoicing transcripts reproduce exactly, including tax and total lines.

Invoicing recomputes rating inline and consumes it as a shared helper (D-10). It must NOT read the persisted RATING_RESULTS: the source reads pkg_rating.g_overage_amount from package globals, and wiring it to the table changes invoice totals.
Tax rate is the source's hardcoded 0.0825, split into two halves that are each left unrounded before summation (D-11). Rounding the halves changes cents on a large fraction of invoices.
Credit notes are applied sequentially in the source's order, including the over-application the sequential burn-down produces (D-12). This cannot be made set-based without changing results.

The source deletes and rebuilds invoice lines on every issue. The target achieves the same end state via MERGE plus a scoped delete of lines for that invoice and ns only — never a table-wide delete, and never DDL on a shared table.
Same pilot exit obligation as silver_rating: dictionary corrections land in 09_ before wave 3, with the observed quarantine rate stated.

planted_anomalies.description: Invoicing depends on rating through package globals rather than a table.
TAX_RATE CONSTANT NUMBER := 0.0825 embedded in the package body.
Tax split into two unrounded halves.
Sequential credit burn-down that can over-apply a credit.
Dynamic SQL in the issue path whose statement text depends on runtime values.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: A tenant with nothing billable produces whatever the source produces — a zero invoice or no invoice — as pinned by the transcripts; the converter does not choose.
